notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
* Bug fixes for the following achievements not being unlocked:
   - Reconciliation Session (Finished August 14th)
   - Reunion (Finished "After: July 18th" on the second playthrough)

* With the above fixes in place, the achievement for unlocking all achievements will now automatically fix itself
   - In the Midst of a Neverending Season (Unlock all achievements)

In order to unlock these, you will need to play through the main game one more time (please note that these will not unlock by watching the sequences in the Extra section)
